# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 4 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1/level-2/level-3 martial chassis baseline to level 4 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from
# the level-1/level-2/level-3 fixtures, adding only the level bump this
# bounded tranche needs. The level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is
# carried forward unchanged — PF1 also grants monks a SEPARATE bonus feat at
# 2nd level, but this slice deliberately does not add a second choice-slot
# for it (no fixture data and no recognition code exist for a level-2 bonus
# feat grant; it stays named but unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2 bonus feat grant
# recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack, AC bonus, or speed
# bonus), no fall-damage engine, and no level-5+ progression. The unarmed
# strike damage die (the 4th-level monk class table row's own die-size step
# to 1d8, verified independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com), the
# ki pool's flat size (a 4th-level monk class feature, verified independently
# against both primary sources: "the number of points in a monk's ki pool is
# equal to 1/2 his monk level + his Wisdom modifier" — no stated minimum in
# the primary rule text), and Slow Fall (the 4th-level monk class feature,
# "a monk within arm's reach of a wall can use it to slow his descent...
# treats the fall as if it were 20 feet shorter") are the three new pillars
# this fixture exercises, all grounded only as bounded flat-magnitude or
# identity records, never wired into any damage-roll, resource-consumption,
# or action-economy engine.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level4
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:4
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
